name: Font Awesome
description: Load a Font Awesome kit on the frontend. Optional integration with the ACF Font Awesome plugin (forwards API key + kit token via filters, fixes a PHP 8 repeater bug). Tokens can come from the settings here or from wp-config constants (`FONT_AWESOME_KIT_TOKEN`, `FONT_AWESOME_API_KEY`) — saved settings win when both are set.

sections.title: Credentials
sections.description: Kit token + API key. Both fall back to wp-config constants when blank — `FONT_AWESOME_KIT_TOKEN` and `FONT_AWESOME_API_KEY` respectively.

sections.title: Frontend loading
sections.description: How the kit script gets onto the page.

sections.title: ACF Font Awesome
sections.description: Only relevant when the ACF Font Awesome plugin is active — these filters no-op when it isn't.

settings.label: Kit token
settings.description: The unique slug at the end of your kit's URL (kit.fontawesome.com/{token}.js). Leave blank to fall back to the FONT_AWESOME_KIT_TOKEN constant.

settings.label: API key
settings.description: Used by the ACF Font Awesome plugin to fetch the icon catalogue. Leave blank to fall back to the FONT_AWESOME_API_KEY constant. Not needed if you're only using the frontend kit.

settings.label: Preconnect to kit.fontawesome.com
settings.description: Emits an early `<link rel=preconnect>` so the browser completes DNS + TCP + TLS before encountering the kit script tag.

settings.label: Enable pseudo-element icons
settings.description: Adds `data-search-pseudo-elements` to the kit script so Font Awesome scans for icons declared via `::before` / `::after` rules. Off by default — it costs DOM-mutation overhead and isn't needed when you only use `<i>` tags.

settings.label: Fix ACF Font Awesome repeater fatal on PHP 8+
settings.description: Re-encodes already-decoded array values back to JSON before the plugin's render_field calls `json_decode` on them. Works around a long-standing bug that only bites when a Font Awesome field is inside an ACF repeater. Leave on unless the plugin author ships their own fix.
